episodes.title: What is Climate Change?
episodes.description: Distinguish weather from climate and compare earlier climate shifts with today's fossil-fuel-driven warming.

episodes.title: Why Do We Release So Much Gas?
episodes.description: Connect energy use and emissions with unequal responsibility for and exposure to climate impacts.

episodes.title: Can We Make Electricity Without Fossil Fuels?
episodes.description: Compare low-carbon electricity options and the advantages and limitations of different energy technologies.

episodes.title: How Can We Store Renewable Energy?
episodes.description: Explore the practical problems of producing, distributing, and storing renewable electricity.

episodes.title: Can We Keep Warm and Stay Cool Without Fossil Fuels?
episodes.description: Investigate ways to reduce emissions from the systems used to heat and cool buildings.

episodes.title: Can We Gas Up… Without Gas?
episodes.description: Compare electric vehicles and approaches to reducing emissions from larger transportation systems.

episodes.title: Can We Capture Greenhouse Gases?
episodes.description: Explore accounting for emissions across production, reducing them, and capturing unavoidable greenhouse gases.

episodes.title: How Will Climate Change Continue to Affect Us?
episodes.description: Examine present climate impacts and possible future consequences for ecosystems and communities.

episodes.title: Are Natural Disasters Actually Natural?
episodes.description: Connect unequal climate harms with social structures and the work of environmental-justice advocates.

episodes.title: How Do Countries Work Together on Climate Change?
episodes.description: Explore international institutions and examples of successful and unsuccessful cooperation on climate policy.

episodes.title: The Hidden Price of Climate Change
episodes.description: Investigate why dependence on fossil fuels persists and how governments and energy companies influence it.

episodes.title: How Can We Respond to Climate Change?
episodes.description: Explore actions governments, businesses, and communities can take to limit further warming.
